documented_probe: Covering task for C-ac4a9918 (declare the mailing-list configuration in the canonical file) at medium difficulty; verifier fully checks the capability (fresh-state provisioning + live daemon routing on hidden mail batches).
notes: Single-stage: discover the canonical config path of the installed listd daemon, author the INI list declarations at /etc/listd/lists.conf via an idempotent provisioning script, and reload the running daemon. The verifier strips the canonical file and restarts the daemon first, so config written anywhere else (or a daemon never reloaded) fails; hidden cases replay distinct mail batches (uppercase addressing, direct-to-subscriber mail, unknown addresses, empty-subscriber list) through the daemon. Nonzero rubric for tool_breadth (ctl script usage), reasoning_depth, debugging_ambiguity (canonical-path discovery), hidden_case_generalization, interaction_statefulness (running daemon must be reloaded).
